summary: Tested the Receipt Archive (list, single-PDF link, ZIP link, access rules) and the friendly branded pages for bad, expired, wrong or missing download links across receipt.pdf, receipts.zip, statements PDF, invoice PDF, report.csv and proof. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests pass. Frontend (390x844): a law-office portal shows 'SIGNED RECEIPTS · 7' with 5 rows, newest first. The SHOW ALL 7 / SHOW FEWER toggle works. PDF and DOWNLOAD ALL (ZIP) open a tab that downloads DashLocal-receipt-<code>.pdf and DashLocal-signed-receipts-<date>.zip, and the green toasts appear. The card is hidden on the mer-1 bakery portal. The friendly page looks right on mobile, and its 'Sign in to your store portal' button goes to /sign-in/merchant. One UX bug: archive rows show only the time (e.g. '11:25'), not the date. Minor: a link with no token at all, or whose store was deleted, still returns raw JSON. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files reviewed.

minor.issue: If the ?token query parameter is missing entirely (e.g. a link cut off at '?'), FastAPI returns a 422 JSON error instead of the friendly page, because token is declared as `token: str`. An empty '?token=' does show the friendly page.

merchant_routes.get_merchant_or_404 raises an HTTPException, so the user gets JSON {"detail":"Merchant not found"} instead of the 'We couldn't find this' page. Reproduced: a valid receipts token for 'mer-deleted-x' returned 404 application/json.

The list is capped at 500 (_signed_stops(…, 500)) while the ZIP includes up to 2000. A store with more than 500 signed receipts would see 'SIGNED RECEIPTS · 500' and could not reach older single receipts from the list. The ZIP builds up to 2000 PDFs one after another in a single request, which risks proxy timeouts and high memory use for big archives.

ui_bugs.issue: Each row shows fmtDepotTime(delivered_at), which prints HH:MM only. In an archive of past receipts, deliveries from different days can't be told apart. It should show a date and time (e.g. 'Mon 27 Oct 2026 · 11:25'). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ReceiptArchive.tsx:52 and /app/frontend/src/api.ts:141.

action_items: ReceiptArchive: show the delivery date as well as the time on each row (ReceiptArchive.tsx:52). fmtDepotTime only gives HH:MM.
Optional: make `token` optional (`token: str = ''`) on the 5 download endpoints so a link with no token also shows the friendly 'This link isn't valid' page instead of a 422 JSON error.
Optional: in receipt.pdf, receipts.zip and statements PDF, catch a missing merchant and raise LinkPageError(kind, 'missing', 404) instead of the HTTPException from get_merchant_or_404.
Optional: line up the list cap (500) with the ZIP cap (2000), or paginate. Consider streaming or a size cap for very large ZIPs.
critical_code_review_comments: receipts.py: the access rules are correct. merchant_access applies to the list and the link; the link checks merchant_id, status delivered and a non-empty signature; a non-law-office store gets 403; download tokens last 5 minutes (verified exp-iat = 300 s).

linkpages.py: titles and the 'how to' text are escaped, no scripts are emitted (verified on localhost), the CSP header is set and the proof page has no button. The Cloudflare edge sometimes injects its own challenge <script> into HTML on the public URL; the page's CSP (default-src 'none') blocks it. This is not an app issue.

ReceiptArchive.tsx: if the receipts query fails, the card just returns null with no error state. That is acceptable for a law-office-only card, but a law office whose API call fails would see nothing.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; one date-display UX bug)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ law-office and plain stores plus cloned TSRA stops on drv-1's active route, and clean them up at teardown. The UI test used a temporary TEST_LawUI store with 7 signed TSRU stops; all removed. drv-1's consent fields were set temporarily and then unset again (they were not set originally). mer-1 was not changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public url> python -m pytest tests/test_receipt_archive_linkpages.py -n0 (about 20-110 s). The Cloudflare edge sometimes injects a cdn-cgi challenge <script> into HTML responses on the public URL, and the test strips it before checking for 'no scripts'. For UI seeding, the driver deliver API needs drv-1's users.phipa_consent_given=true (the conftest sets it for pytest only).
rca_of_issue: Time-only rows: ReceiptArchive reuses fmtDepotTime, which is built for same-day route times (toLocaleTimeString hour/minute).
